endorsements.quote: For successful implementation, a phased strategy is recommended, involving early pilot testing, stakeholder engagement, and comprehensive post-market surveillance with continuous monitoring of defined performance benchmarks.

Moreover, we emphasize the need for foundational AI literacy courses for all healthcare professionals which include pediatric safety considerations, alongside specialized training for those directly involved in pediatric imaging.

unlisted_practices: Develop pediatric-specific safety ratings for AI tools.
Include datasets from diverse pediatric populations in AI development and validation.
Establish quantifiable transparency metrics for AI models.
Ensure AI models are explainable to mitigate bias and ensure appropriateness for use in children.
Engage the public and patients to foster understanding and acceptance of AI in pediatric radiology.
Establish clear protocols for managing discrepancies between AI outputs and clinician interpretations.
